name: Drake Hotline Bling / Drakeposting
visual_description: Two-panel meme with Drake in an orange puffer jacket. Top shows Drake turning away in disgust; bottom shows him smiling and pointing in approval.
usage_context: Used to compare two options, expressing rejection or disapproval of the first and preference or satisfaction with the second.

text_areas.description: Text describing the disliked or rejected concept
